description:
Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) to allow substitution of drawings including alterations to the
configuration of the external balcony wall, and doors to allow access into the existing main entrance of planning permission 00607/152-156/P1 dated 05/12/2019 for external alterations to existing building to include Installation of new full height bi-folding door, new windows and relocated windows to the rear to match the bi-folding doors. Formation of PPC Steel Flat bar balconies. An extended balcony at first floor level overlooking the River, installation of new entrance door to the rear car park side with replacement roller shutter to the car park. Glazed entrance canopy, Crittal style aluminium double glazed entrance door and recessed letter boxes and video entry system and   lighting features to the building to entrances and balconies
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the decision date of the original consent (00607/152-156/P1) dated 05 December 2019.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P001Rev P2, P201 Rev P2, P210 Rev P2, P211 Rev P1, and Design and Access Statement. Received: 08 October 2019; P111 Rev P2, P102 Rev P4 and P200 Rev P3. Received: 29 November 2019. P1101 Rev P1 and P1001 Rev P1. Received: 19 October 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.Reason:  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - Once the hereby approved external alterations are installed they shall only be repaired or replaced in materials and colours to match those hereby approved.
